nodes.label: KFV Freising Logo (White/Inverse Variant)
nodes.description: Inverse/white variant of the KFV Freising logo used on dark backgrounds. Consists of two heraldic shields side by side followed by white text. Left shield: Landkreis Freising coat of arms with Bavarian blue-white diamond pattern (upper left), a crowned Moor's head (lower left), and a white rose on red (lower right). Right shield: Red shield with white fire department symbols — crossed axes, a central wheel (Fahrzeugfeuerwehr symbol), and a flaming grenade at top, representing the Kreisfeuerwehrverband. Text rendered in white for dark backgrounds. Brand colors: red, blue/white Bavarian diamonds, gold/yellow outline, white text.

nodes.label: Landkreis Freising Coat of Arms
nodes.description: Official coat of arms of Landkreis Freising: Bavarian blue-white lozenges (upper-left), crowned Moor head on gold (lower-left), white rose on red (lower-right).

nodes.label: Kreisfeuerwehrverband Fire Department Shield
nodes.description: Red heraldic shield with white fire department insignia: crossed fire axes, spoked wheel center, flaming grenade top. Standard German volunteer fire department association emblem.
